name: Can a home addition increase my property value?

mainEntity.name: Can a home addition increase my property value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a well-designed and constructed home addition can significantly increase your property value, especially in competitive markets like the East Bay. Adding functional living space, such as an extra bedroom, bathroom, or a larger kitchen, is often a worthwhile investment. The return on investment depends on the type of addition and its quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: A well-executed home addition can significantly increase your property value, especially in competitive markets.
